Buenos días!
We had a brief session with META yesterday on Speech & Integrity. It was very simple, basically what they have already
shared publicly about mis/dis information and freedom of expression. I took some screenshots of key slides and I want to
share them with you in case you are interested in going over them.
Saludos,
Claudia Calderón Solis

USAID Honduras
